notes: «أبو كريب، محمد بن العلاء» is one man written twice in succession, so one link with the fuller name (rule 7)

«وعن قيس بن مسلم» is a second isnad for the same saying (the story of Marwan and the hadith of Abu Sa'id), so it is a second group; the shared head (محمد بن العلاء, أبو معاوية, الأعمش) is written in each group because the text starts both routes from al-A'mash
«أبيه» is named only by relation and is kept as a relation link
